# Haira — Full Language Reference for LLMs

> The programming language for AI agents and workflows.
> Build agents and workflows, not boilerplate. Four keywords. One binary.

Haira is a compiled, general-purpose agentic orchestration programming language. It compiles to Go, then to a native binary. Zero dependencies, zero boilerplate.

Website: https://haira.dev
GitHub: https://github.com/mrzdevcore/haira
License: Apache-2.0

---

## Language Primitives

### Variables & Types

```haira
name = "Haira"              // string (inferred)
age: int = 3                // explicit type
pi = 3.14                   // float
active = true               // bool
items = [1, 2, 3]           // list
config = { "key": "value" } // map
```

Primitive types: `string`, `int`, `float`, `bool`, `any`, `nil`
Collection types: `[T]` (list), `map` (string-keyed)
Special types: `file` (for uploads), `stream` (for SSE)

### Functions

```haira
fn add(a: int, b: int) -> int {
    return a + b
}

fn greet(name: string) -> string {
    return "Hello, ${name}!"
}
```

### Control Flow

```haira
if condition {
    // ...
} else if other {
    // ...
} else {
    // ...
}

for item in list {
    // ...
}

for i = 0; i < 10; i += 1 {
    // ...
}

while condition {
    // ...
}
```

### Structs & Enums

```haira
struct User {
    name: string
    email: string
    age: int
}

enum Status {
    Active
    Inactive
    Suspended(reason: string)
}
```

### Pattern Matching

```haira
match value {
    1 | 2 => "low"
    3..=7 => "mid"
    n if n > 100 => "high"
    _ => "other"
}
```

### Error Handling

```haira
result, err = some_call()
if err != nil {
    // handle error
}

// Or with try/catch
try {
    risky_call()?  // ? panics on error
} catch err {
    io.eprintln("Error: ${err}")
}
```

### Pipe Operator

```haira
data |> transform |> filter |> output
```

### Methods

```haira
User.display() -> string {
    return "${self.name} <${self.email}>"
}
```

### Modules & Imports

```haira
import "io"                        // basic
import fmt from "io"               // aliased
import { User } from "models"     // selective
import * from "math"              // glob
```

### Concurrency

```haira
results = spawn {
    Agent1.ask("query 1")
    Agent2.ask("query 2")
    Agent3.ask("query 3")
}
// results is a list of return values
```

---

## Agentic Keywords

### provider — LLM Backend Configuration

```haira
provider openai {
    api_key: env("OPENAI_API_KEY")
    model: "gpt-4o"
}

provider anthropic {
    api_key: env("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY")
    model: "claude-sonnet-4-20250514"
}

provider local {
    endpoint: "http://localhost:11434/v1"
    model: "llama3"
}
```

Any OpenAI-compatible API works — set `endpoint` and `model`.

### tool — Function with LLM-visible Description

```haira
tool search(query: string) -> string {
    """Search the knowledge base for relevant articles."""
    resp, err = http.get("https://api.example.com/search?q=${query}")
    if err != nil { return "Search failed." }
    return resp.body
}
```

Tool descriptions use triple-quotes (`"""..."""`). They are mandatory and compiler-enforced.

### agent — LLM Entity

```haira
agent Assistant {
    provider: openai
    system: "You are a helpful assistant."
    tools: [search, get_weather]
    memory: conversation(max_turns: 10)
    temperature: 0.7
}
```

Agent fields:
- `provider` — which LLM provider to use
- `system` — system prompt
- `tools` — list of tools the agent can call
- `memory` — `conversation(max_turns: N)`, `summary(max_tokens: N)`, or `none`
- `temperature` — LLM temperature (0.0 to 1.0)
- `handoffs` — list of agents this agent can delegate to
- `ui` — enable generative UI (`ui: ui`)

Three ways to call an agent:
```haira
reply, err = Agent.ask("question")           // simple string response
result, err = Agent.run("task")              // structured AgentResult
return Agent.stream(message, session: sid)    // SSE streaming
```

### workflow — Function with HTTP Trigger

```haira
@post("/api/chat")
workflow Chat(message: string, session_id: string) -> { reply: string } {
    reply, err = Assistant.ask(message, session: session_id)
    if err != nil { return { reply: "Error." } }
    return { reply: reply }
}
```

Triggers: `@get`, `@post`, `@put`, `@delete`, `@webhook`

Streaming workflows:
```haira
@post("/chat")
workflow Chat(message: string) -> stream {
    return Assistant.stream(message)
}
```

### Agent Handoffs

```haira
agent FrontDesk {
    provider: openai
    system: "Route billing to BillingAgent, tech to TechAgent."
    handoffs: [BillingAgent, TechAgent]
}

agent BillingAgent {
    provider: openai
    system: "Handle billing questions."
}

agent TechAgent {
    provider: openai
    system: "Handle technical support."
}
```

### Generative UI

```haira
import "ui"

tool show_data(query: string) -> string {
    """Query and display data."""
    rows, err = db.query(query)
    if err != nil {
        return ui.status_card("error", "Query Failed", conv.to_string(err))
    }
    return ui.table("Results", headers, rows)
}
```

Available components:
- `ui.status_card(status, title, message?)` — success/error/warning/info
- `ui.table(title, headers, rows)` — searchable data table
- `ui.chart(type, title, labels, datasets)` — line, bar, pie, scatter, area
- `ui.key_value(title, items)` — labeled property list
- `ui.code_block(title, language, code)` — syntax-highlighted code
- `ui.diff(title, before, after)` — before/after comparison
- `ui.progress(title, steps)` — multi-step progress tracker
- `ui.form(title, fields)` — interactive form
- `ui.confirm(title, message?)` — yes/no dialog
- `ui.choices(title, options)` — option picker
- `ui.product_cards(title, cards)` — product card grid
- `ui.group(child1, child2, ...)` — compose multiple components

### MCP Support

```haira
// MCP Client — use external tools
provider filesystem {
    transport: "mcp"
    command: "npx"
    args: ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "/tmp"]
}

agent Assistant {
    provider: openai
    mcp: [filesystem]
}

// MCP Server — expose workflows as tools
import "mcp"

fn main() {
    mcp_server = mcp.Server([Summarize, Translate])
    mcp_server.listen(9000)
}
```

---

## Standard Library

- `io` — println, eprintln, read_file, write_file
- `http` — HTTP client (get, post, put, delete) and Server
- `json` — parse, stringify
- `strings` — split, join, contains, replace, trim, to_upper, to_lower
- `conv` — to_string, to_int, to_float
- `math` — abs, min, max, floor, ceil, round, sqrt, pow
- `time` — now, sleep, format
- `env` — environment variable access
- `fs` — file system operations
- `regex` — regular expressions
- `array` — push, pop, filter, map, reduce, sort
- `maps` — keys, values, has, merge

### Stdlib Packages (imported separately)

- `postgres` — PostgreSQL client
- `sqlite` — SQLite store backend
- `excel` — Excel file generation
- `vector` — Vector embeddings and similarity search
- `slack` — Slack integration
- `github` — GitHub API client
- `gitlab` — GitLab API client
- `langfuse` — Observability exporter

---

## Server & Deployment

```haira
fn main() {
    server = http.Server([Chat, Analyze, Summarize])
    server.listen(8080)
}
```

The server automatically provides:
- REST endpoints for each workflow
- SSE streaming for `-> stream` workflows
- WebSocket ARP transport at `/_arp/v1`
- Auto-generated UI at `/_ui/`
- File upload handling for `file` parameters

Build and deploy:
```bash
haira build app.haira -o myapp
./myapp  # single binary, zero dependencies
```
